_comment: AmberCell Docker daemon.json stub (Stage-0A). Merge carefully with existing daemon config; restart dockerd after changes.
_userns_remap: Enable userns-remap for production containment baseline, e.g. "userns-remap": "default". Ensure subordinate uid/gid maps exist.
_log_driver: Prefer json-file with size rotation so honeypot syslog floods cannot fill the host disk.
_live_restore: Optional; do not rely on live-restore as a substitute for amberctl teardown order.
_iptables: Production AmberCell uses nftables on the host; avoid Compose-published ports on the production profile. Do not disable Docker iptables without a reviewed networking plan.
